prompt: Generate a film review for a horror movie designed to evoke fear, suspense, or unease. Ensure diversity by including different horror sub-genres (e.g., supernatural, slasher, psychological thriller) and cultural influences (e.g., Western gothic vs. Asian horror tropes). Vary the tone (e.g., terrified, intrigued, or darkly humorous) and reviewer style (e.g., analytical critic, scared viewer, or horror enthusiast) to reflect varied responses.
